description: Initiative 0002 Slice 2: introduce a versioned list payload contract for artefact rows (B-I/B-II/issues), store it in report_rows.payload_json with payload_schema_version, expose via API, and render artefact tables in the UI from locked citations only.

userStories.title: Artefact rows have a versioned list payload
userStories.description: B-I/B-II/issues rows carry a stable, versioned items[] payload with stable item_id and item-level citation_ids for claimed fields, without inventing new report-row statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: Artefact rows include payload_schema_version='list_payload_v0' and payload_json.items[].
Each item has stable item_id and item-level citation_ids[] for claimed fields; unsupported fields are downgraded (no fabrication).
Item-level states (match_status, depicted/not_depicted/unknown) do not invent or reuse report-row statuses.

userStories.title: UI renders artefact tables from payload and locked citations
userStories.description: UI renders artefact tables from payload_json (not answer prose) and item-level citation chips jump to evidence using locked citations.
acceptanceCriteria: UI renders artefact rows from payload_json only; it does not parse report_rows.answer prose for table rendering.
Clicking a citation uses GET /citations/:id and highlights evidence in the viewer (dependency: Initiative 0001).
If payload is missing/invalid, UI shows a safe error state using the standard error envelope and trace_id (no internal leak).
